verdict.rationale: Missive documents an official MCP server that lets external AI apps such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor act on your conversations, contacts, calendar, and drafts with permissions you choose. The changelog shows reading (summarize inbox), triage (against your CRM), and drafting through it, but no evidence shows an external agent can actually send email, so the end-to-end loop is unproven. missing for 10: documented send capability via MCP/API for external agents, independent or hands-on corroboration, detailed MCP server tool reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an external agent — Claude, ChatGPT, or my own — can read, triage, draft, and send my email end to end through a documented connection

citations.quote: External AI apps like Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor can now connect to Missive through the Model Context Protocol and act on your conversations, contacts, calendar, and drafts, with the permissions you choose.
Ask Claude to summarize your inbox and draft replies without leaving the chat
Let an agent triage new conversations against your CRM before you look at them
Drafts created outside the composer, by the assistant, by a rule, or through the API and MCP server, now resolve {{ user.name }} and {{ user.email }} from your organization profile
